changelog:
Initial release of the Roon music controller skill:

- Enables control of your Roon music system (playback, queue, search, volume, skipping).
- Supports full REST API integration for searching your library/TIDAL and controlling all playback features.
- Clearly documents each available API endpoint, request method, and correct parameter usage.
- Provides examples for common music requests, including track/album play, volume adjustment, shuffle, and playlist creation.
- Includes best practices and critical notes for reliable automation and future improvements.
summary: Controls Roon music system via API to search, play tracks or albums, manage queues, adjust volume, shuffle, and control playback on specified zones.
